Name: The Ranch Country Club
Description: This is where I play golf with my brother and dad, so it’s tied to some of my favorite family memories. It’s one of those places that instantly feels familiar and fun every time I’m there.

Name: Sierra
Description: This is one of my favorite spots when I’m down in the Lone Tree area. I like the atmosphere and it’s a go-to place I’d take someone who wants a nicer meal without it feeling too formal.

Name: Los Dos Potrillos (Highlands Ranch)
Description: This is my favorite Mexican restaurant around Highlands Ranch. It’s the kind of place I keep coming back to because the food is consistently great and it feels like a reliable local staple.

Name: Chatfield State Park
Address: 11500 N Roxborough Park Rd, Littleton, CO 80125
Description: This is where I go wake surfing and paddle boarding, so it’s one of my main summer spots. It’s a place I associate with being outside, being on the water, and spending full days doing something active.

Name: Vail Village
Address: 241 S Frontage Rd W Suite 8150, Vail, CO 81657
Description: Vail is my favorite place to ski, and it’s the spot I think of when I picture a perfect winter trip. The village and the mountain both feel like the classic Colorado ski experience.

Name: Pearl Street Mall
Description: Pearl Street is one of the best places to walk around in Boulder because there are so many shops and good places to eat. It’s a go-to place to bring people because it always has energy and things to do.

Name: New Castle (Town Hall)
Address: 450 W Main St, New Castle, CO 81647
Description: New Castle matters to me because it’s where my family ranch is and where I spend time hunting and being outdoors. I used Town Hall as a public reference point, but the place represents some of my most personal Colorado memories.

Name: Red Rocks Park & Amphitheatre
Description: Red Rocks is one of the best concert venues in the U.S. and it feels uniquely Colorado. Even outside of concerts, it’s a place that’s worth seeing because the setting and views are unreal.

Name: Matsuhisa Denver
Description: This is some of my favorite sushi in Colorado, and it’s a spot I’d pick when I want a meal that feels like an experience. It’s a go-to recommendation for someone visiting Denver who wants something special.

Name: Golden Welcome Center (Downtown Golden)
Description: I like Golden because it has great food and beer, and it’s easy to mix downtown with outdoor activities in the same day. It’s one of the best places to hang out and explore without needing a strict plan.
